contradictions.a: οἱ μὲν περὶ Ἀριστόβουλον (fr. 29) οὐκ ἂν συγχωροῖεν, οἳ φάσκοντες, μὴ ὔεσθαι τὰ πεδία.
contradictions.b: hoi peri Aristoboulon ouk an homologoien, phaskontes gar hyein epi tōn pediōn.
contradictions.why: A says Aristobulus claims the plains do not rain; B says he claims they do rain.

contradictions.a: οὐκέτι δὲ καὶ τὸ μέλανας εἶναι καὶ οὐλότριχας τοὺς Αἰθίοπας, ἐν ψιλοῖς τοῖς ὕδασιν τὴν αἰτίαν τι-
contradictions.b: ou mentoi eti orthōs poiei, tēn aitian tōn Aithiōpōn melainōn kai oulotrichōn ontōn haplōs eis to hydōr tithemenos
contradictions.why: A implies the theory is wrong because it attributes the cause solely to water; B explicitly states it is wrong to attribute it 'simply' (haplōs) to water.

omissions.a: κατεσκευασμένων δὲ ἀμφοτέρων ἐγκοιλίων μητρῶν χωρίς

additions.b: kai oneidizei Theodektē tēn aitian eis auton ton hēlion anapemptonti, kathaper ekeinos ho syngrapheus phēsin: kai toi Onesikritos an echoi tina logon; phēsi gar ton hēlion mēden enguterō einai tois Aithiōsin ē tois allois, alla mallon kata katheton epikeisthai kai dia touto mallon kaiein. houtō de phēsin ou kalōs eirēsthai ton hēlion "prosōrion" einai autois, epeidē ison diastēma pantōn esti. epicheirei de kai hoti hē thermotēs ouk aitia esti toiautēs katastaseōs, epeidē ouch houtōs echei tois en tē mētra, hous ho hēlios ou thigganei.
